title: NTN Registration in Pakistan and Why Being on the Active Taxpayer List Matters
description: How to get an NTN in Pakistan, what the Active Taxpayer List (ATL) means, and how filer vs non-filer status changes withholding tax on your payments.
lead: How to get an NTN in Pakistan, what the Active Taxpayer List (ATL) means, and how filer vs non-filer status changes withholding tax on your payments.
body:
The National Tax Number (NTN) is your identity with the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR). Individuals, associations of persons and companies all need one to file income tax returns, register for sales tax and deal with banks, customs and government departments.

Who needs an NTN?

Salaried persons above the taxable threshold, business owners, freelancers, exporters, importers, property investors and every company should hold an NTN. Even if your income is low, being registered and filing a return is useful as proof of income for visas, bank loans and business contracts.

What is the Active Taxpayer List (ATL)?

The ATL is the FBR list of persons who have filed their income tax return for the relevant period. Being on the list means you are treated as a filer. Many withholding tax rates in Pakistan are significantly higher for persons who are not on the list. This applies to payments such as bank profit, cash withdrawals, property purchases, vehicle registration and many business payments.

Filer vs non-filer: the practical impact

  • Higher withholding rates on banking transactions and purchases
  • Higher advance tax on property and vehicle transactions
  • Possible restrictions in dealing with some departments and banks
  • Weaker position when applying for loans or tenders

How to stay active

  1. Register your NTN online through the FBR portal.
  2. Keep records of salary slips, bank statements, invoices and expenses.
  3. File the annual income tax return before the due date.
  4. Keep your wealth statement and reconciliations consistent year to year.
